'''Hoang Nguyen''' won the [[1997 Bespin Regionals (St. Louis)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Heading into the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], Decipher published this player statement.

"I am 24 years-old and a Senior majoring in Manufacturing Engineering Technology at the University of Nebraska at Omaha."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/nguyen.html Hoang Nguyen], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428013930/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/nguyen.html Internet Archive]</ref>
"I've been happily married to my wife Christel for about 9 months now and we're expecting a baby girl by the end of January!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"My hobbies are computers, as well as playing Star Wars CCG whenever I have the opportunity."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'm also an avid football fan of the New York Giants (currently in first place in the NFC East might I add!)."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"I'd also like to tell everyone that anyone can win at StarWars CCG."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"The only thing you have to remember is to learn from your mistakes and never underestimate your opponent."<ref name="dec97bio" />
"One other thing, always play for the win and not for differential!"<ref name="dec97bio" />
"You can."<ref name="dec97bio" />
